data.revised_prompt: Logo mark for Lingban Ciyuan, an AI task automation product. Create a simple minimal friendly little ghost mascot. Logo-only icon, no Chinese text, no English text, no letters, no watermark. Centered composition, app icon ready, clean vector-friendly shape, generous padding. The ghost should feel intelligent, efficient, trustworthy, and approachable. Avoid scary horror style, complex scene, clutter, mockup, 3D text, photorealistic mascot. Style: fresh productivity icon. Color palette: white ghost, mint green outline, pale mint rounded-square background, calm and efficient.
